# Theme credits

Cadence's themes borrow fonts, techniques and code from these open-source projects. Thank you.

| Used in | Project | License | What we use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ninety-Five | [98.css](https://github.com/jdan/98.css) by Jordan Scales | MIT (`98css/LICENSE`) | Pixelated MS Sans Serif webfonts, bevel box-shadow recipe |
| Chicago | [system.css](https://github.com/sakofchit/system.css) by Sakun Acharige | MIT (`systemcss/LICENSE`) | ChiKareGo2 and ChicagoFLF fonts (recreations by @blogmywiki), 1-bit window style |
| Cyberpunk | [augmented-ui](https://github.com/propjockey/augmented-ui) by PropJockey | BSD-2-Clause (`augmented-ui/LICENSE`) | the whole library (clipped corners, inlays) |
| Doodle Party | [css-doodle](https://github.com/css-doodle/css-doodle) by Yuan Chuan | MIT (`css-doodle/LICENSE`) | the web component, for the generative background |
| NES | [NES.css](https://github.com/nostalgic-css/NES.css) | MIT | pixel-border technique (re-implemented) |
| NES, Terminal, CRT, Sketchbook | Press Start 2P, VT323, Comic Neue via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-*.txt`) | webfonts |
| Sketchbook | [PaperCSS](https://github.com/papercss/papercss) | ISC | wobbly hand-drawn border-radius technique (re-implemented) |
| Tufte | [Tufte CSS](https://github.com/edwardtufte/tufte-css) by Dave Liepmann | MIT (`tufte/LICENSE`) | ET Book webfont (MIT, by Dmitry Krasny, Bonnie Scranton and Edward Tufte), typography rules |
| XP, Seven | [XP.css](https://github.com/botoxparty/XP.css) by Adam Hammad, [7.css](https://github.com/khang-nd/7.css) by Khang Nguyen | MIT | Luna / Aero look (gradients re-implemented, no Microsoft assets) |
| daisyUI set (30) | [daisyUI](https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui) by Pouya Saadeghi | MIT (`daisyui-LICENSE`) | theme colours and radii, converted from OKLCH by `scripts/build-daisy-themes.mjs` |
| Editor set | [Dracula](https://draculatheme.com), [One Dark](https://github.com/atom/atom), [Tokyo Night](https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme), [Catppuccin](https://catppuccin.com), [Gruvbox](https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox), [Rosé Pine](https://rosepinetheme.com), [Night Owl](https://github.com/sdras/night-owl-vscode-theme), [GitHub Primer](https://primer.style), [Ayu](https://github.com/ayu-theme), [Everforest](https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest), [Kanagawa](https://github.com/rebelot/kanagawa.nvim), [SynthWave ’84](https://github.com/robb0wen/synthwave-vscode), Monokai | MIT (palettes) | published colour palettes only |
| Neo-Brutal, Neo-Brutal Sky | [NeoBrutalismCSS](https://github.com/matifandy8/NeoBrutalismCSS) by Matías Fandiño | MIT (`neobrutalism/LICENSE`) | palette, 3.5px borders / hard-shadow recipe (re-implemented); Lexend Mega + Public Sans via Fontsource (OFL, `fonts/OFL-*.txt`) |
